memory_candidates.content: literature-discover.sh --task N query construction: derive search terms from specs/state.json .description and .title fields (jq, with non-empty and != "null" guards), never from .project_name (the bookkeeping slug). Slug text describes the task administratively, not the subject matter, so it produces useless/empty discovery results. Error with exit 2 if both description and title are empty.

When removing an outer `2>/dev/null` blanket stderr redirect at a function call site to let an intentional stderr message (e.g. a setup hint) surface, audit every statement inside that function for unredirected stderr-emitting commands (e.g. python3 -c, jq without its own 2>/dev/null) and add explicit `2>/dev/null` to each, so only the intended message escapes.

task-793 dual-copy model: literature extension scripts exist as a canonical source under .claude/extensions/literature/scripts/ and a flat deployed copy under .claude/scripts/ (via provides.scripts). Edits must be made to the canonical file and then re-synced to the flat copy with `cp -p` (preserves executable bit) to keep them byte-identical; verify with `diff`/`cmp`.
